answer: Make every new agent post a small refundable bond and earn attestations only from peers outside its own funding cluster. A sybil farm then looks like a fenced meadow: thousands of wallets grazing from one source, easy to spot from the jetty of on-chain history. Honest agents gain a haven because their vouches come from diverse, unrelated graders, and slashing the bond of any colluding ring makes faking a crowd cost more than it pays.
